dryRun.description: Validate and project the WorkItems and cards without persisting them.

requireApproval.description: Require an approved canonical upstream review-gate result before writing.

executionMode.description: Default work-item execution mode when a producer did not specify one. Auto dispatch uses the shared durable workflow-delivery path; manual remains user-initiated.

maxAttempts.description: Default bounded automatic-delivery attempts when the producer did not specify one.
